This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed player hits at least one home run in any game of the 2026 MLB Playoffs American League Division Series between the Cleveland Guardians and Chicago White Sox. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Only home runs credited to the listed player in the official box score will count. Inside-the-park home runs count toward this market. All innings of each game, including extra innings, will be considered. A game that is postponed or suspended will count once it has been completed. Official scoring changes announced by MLB within 24 hours of the end of the relevant game will be considered, but later changes will not.

If the series is not completed by October 24, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, for any reason, including cancellation of the 2026 MLB Playoffs, this market will resolve based on games of the series completed by that time. A home run hit in a game that has been suspended and not completed by that time will not count.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from MLB, including official box scores; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
